translations.source_sense_description: eine Speise mit Trüffeln würzen oder verfeinern

glosses: Any of various edible fungi, of the genus Tuber, that grow in the soil in southern Europe; the earthnut.

examples.text: In ancient times, the Romans imported truffles, credited with marked aphrodisiac virtue, from Libya as well as Greece.

glosses: Ellipsis of chocolate truffle (“creamy chocolate confection, in the form of a ball, covered with cocoa powder”).
